Term Set Description: What a news post or notice is about. Health and Safety drives the Safety section on HPUK News.

Term Description: General corporate announcements of broad employee interest.
A change or update to normal operational activity.
Organisational or employee changes that aren't simply HR process guidance.
Safety information, campaigns and notices to protect employees and visitors. Posts in this category appear in the Safety section of HPUK News.
Security information that needs particular awareness or action.
Changes to applications, IT services, Microsoft 365 or other business systems.
Progress, milestones or outcomes from a defined project or programme.
New or revised organisational rules, standards or governance arrangements.
How to do a task, use a service or follow a process, including guidance for site owners and publishers.
Community engagement, volunteering, fundraising and charitable activity.
Environmental performance, sustainability programmes and related initiatives.
Internal information about customers, services or commercial developments.
An unplanned interruption to an operational or business service.
Scheduled work expected to affect a service, site, system or facility.
Useful internal information that genuinely doesn't fit a more specific category.
